names.description: The target proxy's and URL map's names in full (not Terraform variables; docs/design.md, "Names, labels and tags"). A name set here takes no prefix.

namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable): <namePrefix>- in front of every name the chart derives or is given in an entry. A DNS label. Empty changes nothing.

labels.description: fabric's labels: Kubernetes labels on every object; unprefixed ones also become Google Cloud labels on the forwarding rules.

tags.description: Cloud labels on every resource that takes them (Google Cloud labels: lower-case letters, digits, _ and -).

addresses.description: Optional IP addresses used for the forwarding rules, mapped by subnetwork key.

backend_service_configs.description: Backend service level configuration, by key.

context.description: fabric's context interpolations; refused when set.

group_configs.description: Optional unmanaged groups to create. Can be referenced in backends via key or outputs.

health_check_configs.description: Optional auto-created health check configurations, by key; null is fabric's default (an HTTP check on the serving port, key default), {} creates none.

neg_configs.description: Optional network endpoint groups to create. Can be referenced in backends via key or outputs.

ports.description: Optional ports for HTTP load balancer. Application Load Balancer supports at most one port per forwarding rule.

protocol.description: Protocol supported by this load balancer.

service_directory_registration.description: Service directory namespace and service used to register this load balancer; refused when set.

urlmap_config.description: The URL map configuration; null is fabric's default, {default_service: default}.

deletion_policy.description: DELETE (default) or ABANDON (not a fabric variable).
